C1412.title: Crypto Scams: 2021 Rug Pulls Push Revenues Near All-Time High
C1412.summary: Chainalysis reports that rug pulls accounted for 37% of all cryptocurrency scam revenue in 2021, compared to just 1% in 2020, indicating they have become one of the dominant scam types in the DeFi ecosystem.
